summary: All 29 patch captures reviewed: 22 distinct images directly inspected and seven byte-identical copies matched by SHA-256. Four screen BitBlt captures show the actual 960-pixel minimum workspace; fixed navigation and the right edge are contained. Empty/populated Results and updater/setup dialogs are legible.
limitations: Only the ordinary path of candidate 4734286 in this run is covered; the spaces gate result is separate.
Observed Windows Server 2022 at 96 DPI; no representative-PC, high-DPI, multiple-monitor or physical-trackpad acceptance.
25 captures use PrintWindow, which asks the app to paint; four use screen BitBlt without PrintWindow repaint. Static captures do not establish temporal repaint quality or keyboard correctness.
Actual workspace sizes are 960x680 and 1024x728. Requested 1280x900 was bounded to 1024x728.
Fresh workflow PrintWindow captures omit the General settings heading, while the matching 960-pixel screen capture displays it; do not generalize PrintWindow capture pixels to every on-screen state.
Screenshots show scrollable panels at their captured offsets, not every field or list row.
